findings.source: VRFCoordinatorV2_5.sol:477-479 for (uint256 i = 0; i < numWords; ++i) { randomWords[i] = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(randomness, i))); }
findings.issue: Each random word is printed as the hash of a memory range whose length is '_285 - mem[64] + 64' (that is, 64), so the derivation keccak(randomness, i) is not visible although both words are known: randomness = sha3(3, gamma) and i.
findings.rule: With mem[64] >= 0x80 established (all stores to it are constants >= 0x80 or increments), writes at mem[64] + 32 and _285 + 64 do not alias mem[64], so _285 - mem[64] = 0 and the length is 64; sha3(mem[p + 32 len 64]) with known words at p + 32 and p + 64 is sha3(w1, w2).

findings.decompiled: if 0 >= stor17.length: revert with 0x5428d449, _to / mem[0] = 17 / _3 = sha3(17) / s = 0 / while -_to + address(stor[_3 + s]): / if SafeMath.inc(s) >= stor17.length: revert with 0x5428d449, _to / ... s = SafeMath.inc(s)
findings.source: VRFCoordinatorV2_5.sol:720-727 for (uint256 i = 0; i < migrationTargetsLength; ++i) { if (s_migrationTargets[i] == target) return true; } return false; with migrate: if (!_isTargetRegistered(newCoordinator)) revert CoordinatorNotRegistered(newCoordinator)
findings.issue: The search loop is rotated: its test is the comparison written as a difference '-_to + address(stor[_3 + s])', the index test sits in the body, and the element is raw stor[sha3(17) + s] although the same array is stor17[idx] in registerMigratableCoordinator (207).
findings.rule: A nonzero test of a - b reads as a != b. stor[keccak(p) + i] for an array slot p with one-word elements is storP[i], whether the hash is a temporary or inline.

notes: Source loops counted are those in this bytecode: OptimismL1Fees calls the GasPriceOracle predeploy (OVM_GASPRICEORACLE.getL1Fee / getL1FeeUpperBound are external calls), so GasPriceOracle._getCalldataGas and LibZip.flzCompress (seven loops in the pack) are not here; VRF._projectiveECAdd's 'for (' is a comment. Loop map: deregisterMigratableCoordinator (327), deregisterProvingKey (416), fulfillRandomWords' numWords loop (1718), VRF._fieldHash 'while x >= FIELD_SIZE' (1442, 1508), VRF._hashToCurve 'while not on curve' (1499, as the addmod/mulmod curve test), getActiveSubscriptionIds (504), migrate's consumer loop (1247), pendingRequestExists (179 and inlined in removeConsumer 537 / cancelSubscription 705), removeConsumer (545), _deleteSubscription (636, 714, 1149), _isTargetRegistered (207, 1069 rotated). Implicit: six two-element 'while idx < 2' copies of uint256[2] proof fields, four checked-exponentiation loops ('while u > 1: if s > -1 / s'), storage-to-memory consumer copies (two rotated, P3), ABI encode and bytes copies (P7). fulfillRandomWords (900 lines) reviewed by structure: proof decode, key-hash lookup, commitment check, VRF verification, random-words loop, callback with gas checks, payment and the Optimism L1 fee call; the rest are short subscription/admin functions, checked.
summary: Faithful, every in-bytecode source loop is a while; the random-word derivation and a few array accesses are obscured by the unresolved free-memory pointer and raw storage arithmetic.
